subject.title: message tool: Feishu send action polluted by poll schema/guard prevents file send

question: Should `message.send` hide/strip content-bearing poll fields that models add from the shared schema, or keep rejecting them as explicit poll intent?
rationale: Current main intentionally keeps the strict guard for `pollQuestion` and `pollOption`, while the report and linked PR argue those fields can be schema-padding noise; that is a model-facing contract choice, not just a mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Action-scope poll fields
options.body: Move poll creation fields out of the plain send schema and keep real poll validation in the poll action, then update the linked fix or replacement PR around that contract.

options.title: Sanitize send params
options.body: Strip poll creation params from send before the guard, accepting that accidental content-bearing poll fields are ignored instead of rejected.

options.title: Keep strict guard
options.body: Document that content poll fields on send are hard errors and close only after maintainers decide the reported model-padding behavior is not supported.

recommendation.title: Action-scope poll fields
recommendation.body: Move poll creation fields out of the plain send schema and keep real poll validation in the poll action, then update the linked fix or replacement PR around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent release history point to this owner for the active message-tool/poll helper surface.
